row.name: vectors
row.technical_description: Equal-weight ordered mean of finite equally shaped one-dimensional vectors, converted to float64. Requires a nonempty list or tuple of vectors; individual empty vectors are permitted. Sum in caller order then divide by count; reject overflow. No broadcasting, calibration, class ordering or split policy. Returns a new float64 vector.
row.dejargonized_description: Average equally sized lists of scores in the supplied order.
